item.title: FCC Waives Foreign Ownership Rule for Paramount‑Warner
item.description: The FCC grants a 49.5% equity waiver to Saudi, Qatari and Abu Dhabi funds in the Paramount‑Warner merger, raising regulatory and geopolitical concerns.
